mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_settings (key, value) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE banned_at IS NULL AND email_verified_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS learners, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FROM activity_days a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.activity_date >= #{weekAgo} AND u.banned_at IS NULL AND u.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS active_this_week, (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_progress)::int AS lessons_completed, (SELECT count(*) FROM activity_days)::int AS practice_days, (SELECT count(*) FROM squads)::int AS squads
SELECT level, count(*)::int AS learners FROM users WHERE level IS NOT NULL AND banned_at IS NULL AND email_verified_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY level ORDER BY level
